discovery.rule: Never hard-code the active project set in an operator prompt. Load enabled projects from the portfolio registry on every cycle.

generationRule: A generation advances only when new real work is produced or verified: code, capability, bug fix, UX, integration, functional test, performance, resilience, security or another concrete product improvement. Administrative ref/checkpoint churn alone is not a generation.
onboardingRule: A new project joins RAZZO by adding one enabled entry to razzo/projects.json. The universal operator command and scheduled tasks must not be edited for project onboarding.
